export_table_to_dataframe: export a Table object to a Pandas DataFrame with multi-level column headers
export_table_to_html: export a Table object to an HTML string with rowspan and colspan attributes
export_table_to_document_tokens: export a Table object to a document tokens format with location, caption, and cell data

export_text_to_document_tokens: export a BaseText object to a document tokens format with location and content
